# seerr_plex_users (Data Source)

Fetch the list of registered users on the connected Plex server for selection and import.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `total` (Number) Total number of users found on the Plex server.
- `users` (Attributes List) List of users registered on Plex. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Plex user email address.
- `id` (String) Plex user ID.
- `thumb` (String) User avatar / thumbnail URL.
- `title` (String) User title / display name.
- `user_type` (String) User type on Plex.
- `username` (String) Plex username.
